lines.t: In the valley where shadows fall,
I wandered far, I heard Your call.
Your voice like thunder, pure and clear,
Brought peace to calm my every fear.
You make the crooked paths straight,
You lift the humble from the weight.
Your hand restores what was torn apart,
You write Your truth upon my heart.
The hills are leveled by Your word,
The lost are found, the dead are stirred.
From dust to life, from fear to grace,
You shine Your light in every place.
You make the crooked paths straight,
You lift the humble from the weight.
Your hand restores what was torn apart,
You write Your truth upon my heart.
Every knee will bow in awe,
Every soul will see Your law.
Mercy flows like rivers wide,
Justice reigns, and love abides.
You make the crooked paths straight,
You make the crooked paths straight,
Your ways are perfect, strong, and great.
You lead us home through Heaven’s gate,
Forever true — You make us straight.
